summary: Sets or clears bit 7 (0x80) of the flag word at this+0x0 based on the boolean a2 (non-zero sets, zero clears), then calls DirectXVertexBufferTextureCoordinateSetup passing the global dword_8B78A0, this pointer, the field at this+0x4, and constant 1. Returns the DirectX call's result. Invoked by sub_4FCEE0 and sub_55A500.

local_names.a2: boolean flag control: non-zero sets bit 7, zero clears bit 7
local_names.v2: current flag word read from this+0x0
local_names.v3: updated flag word written back to this+0x0
local_names.this[1]: field at offset 0x4 passed to the DirectX setup call

operations.description: Read the current flag word: v2 = *this.
Branch on a2: non-zero selects the bit-7 set path, zero selects the bit-7 clear path.
Store the updated flag word: *this = v3.
Return the DirectX setup call's result.
Invoked by sub_4FCEE0 and sub_55A500 during DirectX vertex/texture management.
